description: Default-deny capability for the main window — no fs:, no shell:, only core defaults, window management, and the narrow dialog:allow-open grant for the project registration folder picker (T-01-02). Tauri v2's ACL/permission system gates PLUGIN commands (dialog:*, core:*); this app's own #[tauri::command] handlers are not plugin commands and are exposed solely via main.rs's generate_handler! list, which is the actual default-deny boundary for them — no permissions/ directory defines custom ACL entries for them in this project, so listing them here would have no runtime effect (verified empirically: project_register/project_list/task_create/board_list from plan 01-03 already work without such an entry). Full app-command roster, kept here for auditability since generate_handler! is the enforcement point: project_register, project_list, task_create, task_update, task_delete, task_set_status, task_reorder, task_set_priority, task_set_estimate, task_set_assignee, epic_create, epic_update, epic_delete, epic_set_status, epic_reorder, epic_set_priority, epic_set_estimate, epic_set_assignee, issue_create, issue_update, issue_delete, issue_reorder, board_list, board_search, actor_list, criterion_create, criterion_update, criterion_toggle, criterion_reorder, criterion_delete, criterion_list. board_search (plan 01-08, BOARD-06) is named explicitly here rather than covered by any blanket grant (T-01-02) — free-text search and every filter dimension still run as indexed, parameterised SQL inside packages/core, this command only carries the request/response across the IPC boundary.
